items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So Meadows, Jayne Meadows, they put us in their company.

ctx.x: Art came in as the other group. They always hire two groups at The Five Spot. First, it was Randy Weston and his quartet. So, Art came in with Jerry Mulligan. The first (inaudible), Benny said, "Curtis, going to try and put a group together. You write good for sextet. Why don't we get this group? I talked to Donald Byrd about it and he wants to do it." Donald really didn't want to do it. I knew Donald he was going for a bigger shot with The Blackbirds. But, he was bending his first choice. It got to be and we had…
So it was originally a cooperative group?
